request: why are there 60 minutes in an hour?

beats.intent: 60 dots arranged as a 6 by 10 grid
beats.narration: Sixty is a friendly number: it splits evenly in lots of ways.
beats.code:
stage.title("Why 60?")
dots = draw_dots(stage, n=60, cols=10, color=YELLOW)
stage.caption("60 = 6 × 10")

beats.intent: The same 60 dots regrouped as 4 by 15 and 5 by 12
beats.narration: It is six tens, four fifteens, five twelves, three twenties.

beats.intent: Bars comparing how many numbers divide 60 (12) and 100 (9)
beats.narration: Sixty has twelve divisors. A hundred, though bigger, has only nine.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [12, 9], labels=["60", "100"], color=GREEN)
stage.caption("how many whole numbers divide it")

beats.narration: So an hour splits neatly into halves, thirds, quarters, fifths and sixths: probably why the ancient Babylonians counted in sixties.

request: why are bulbs in parallel brighter than bulbs in series?

beats.intent: A battery with two bulbs in a single loop, one after the other, both dim
beats.narration: Wire two bulbs one after the other in a single loop: in series. The current has to push through both.
beats.code:
stage.title("Series and parallel")
loop1 = Rectangle(width=4.0, height=2.4, color=GREY_B).move_to([-3.3, -0.3, 0])
bat1 = Rectangle(width=0.3, height=0.8, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(loop1.get_left())
b1 = Circle(radius=0.3, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to(loop1.get_top() + 0.8 * LEFT)
b2 = Circle(radius=0.3, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to(loop1.get_top() + 0.8 * RIGHT)
stage.play(Create(loop1), FadeIn(bat1), FadeIn(b1), FadeIn(b2))
stage.add(loop1, bat1, b1, b2)
stage.label(loop1, "series", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: A second circuit where each bulb has its own branch across the battery, both bright
beats.narration: Now give each bulb its own branch: in parallel. Each one gets the battery's full push.
beats.code:
loop2 = Rectangle(width=4.0, height=2.4, color=GREY_B).move_to([3.0, -0.3, 0])
mid = Line(loop2.get_top() + 0.2 * RIGHT, loop2.get_bottom() + 0.2 * RIGHT, color=GREY_B)
bat2 = Rectangle(width=0.3, height=0.8, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(loop2.get_left())
c1 = Circle(radius=0.3, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.95).move_to(mid.get_center())
c2 = Circle(radius=0.3, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.95).move_to(loop2.get_right())
stage.play(Create(loop2), Create(mid), FadeIn(bat2), FadeIn(c1), FadeIn(c2))
stage.add(loop2, mid, bat2, c1, c2)
stage.label(loop2, "parallel", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: Bars of brightness: series bulbs 1/4 each, parallel bulbs 1 each
beats.narration: In series each bulb gets half the voltage and half the current: a quarter of the power. In parallel, each shines at full power.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [0.25, 0.25, 1, 1], labels=["series 1", "series 2", "parallel 1", "parallel 2"], color=YELLOW)
stage.caption("power in each bulb")

beats.intent: The bars beside P = V² / R: half the voltage gives a quarter of the power
beats.narration: Power goes as voltage squared over resistance, so halving the voltage quarters it.

beats.intent: Sea at the bottom, a mountain on the right, the Sun above, arrows of vapour rising from the sea
beats.narration: The Sun warms the sea, and water evaporates, rising as invisible vapour.
beats.code:
stage.title("The water cycle")
sea = Rectangle(width=6, height=0.8, stroke_width=0, fill_color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to([-2.5, -2.6, 0])
hill = Polygon([0.5, -3.0, 0], [5.5, -3.0, 0], [3.5, 0.2, 0], color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.4)
sun = Circle(radius=0.5, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([-5.2, 2.2, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(sea), FadeIn(hill), FadeIn(sun))
stage.add(sea, hill, sun)
vapour = VGroup(*[Arrow([x, -2.1, 0], [x, 0.3, 0], buff=0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=3) for x in (-4, -2.8, -1.6)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[GrowArrow(a) for a in vapour], lag_ratio=0.2))
stage.add(vapour)
stage.caption("evaporation")

beats.intent: A cloud forming high up and drifting over the mountain
beats.narration: High up it cools and condenses into tiny droplets: a cloud. Wind carries it towards the land.
beats.code:
cloud = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=r, color=GREY_A, fill_opacity=0.9, stroke_width=0).move_to([x, 1.2 + y, 0]) for x, y, r in ((-2.6, 0, 0.5), (-2.0, 0.2, 0.6), (-1.4, 0, 0.5))])
stage.play(FadeIn(cloud))
stage.play(cloud.animate.shift(5.3 * RIGHT), run_time=2)
stage.add(cloud)
stage.caption("condensation")

beats.intent: Rain falling from the cloud onto the mountain
beats.narration: Over the mountain the droplets join, grow heavy and fall as rain.
beats.code:
drops = VGroup(*[Line([x, 0.6, 0], [x - 0.1, 0.1, 0], color=BLUE) for x in np.linspace(2.4, 4.4, 8)])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(d) for d in drops], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(drops)
stage.caption("precipitation")

beats.intent: A river running down the mountain back to the sea, closing the loop
beats.narration: Rivers carry the water downhill back to the sea, and the cycle starts again.
beats.code:
river = VMobject(color=BLUE, stroke_width=6).set_points_smoothly([[3.2, -0.3, 0], [2.4, -1.4, 0], [1.2, -2.2, 0], [0.4, -2.5, 0]])
stage.play(Create(river))
stage.add(river)
stage.caption("collection: back to the sea")

request: how does a pin tumbler lock work?

beats.intent: A lock cylinder with five pin stacks pushed down across the shear line by springs
beats.narration: Inside a lock, spring-loaded pins cross the gap between the turning plug and the fixed body, so the plug can't turn.
beats.code:
stage.title("A pin tumbler lock")
body = Rectangle(width=7, height=1.4, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to([0, 1.1, 0])
plug = Rectangle(width=7, height=1.4, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to([0, -0.3, 0])
shear = DashedLine([-3.5, 0.4, 0], [3.5, 0.4, 0], color=RED)
stage.play(FadeIn(body), FadeIn(plug), Create(shear))
stage.add(body, plug, shear)
stage.label(shear, "shear line", direction=RIGHT, color=RED)
cuts = [0.9, 0.5, 1.1, 0.7, 0.4]
xs = np.linspace(-2.6, 2.6, 5)
tops, bots = VGroup(), VGroup()
for x, c in zip(xs, cuts):
    bots.add(Rectangle(width=0.35, height=c, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([x, 0.4 - c / 2 + 0.3, 0]))
    tops.add(Rectangle(width=0.35, height=0.7, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to([x, 0.4 + 0.35 + 0.3, 0]))
stage.play(FadeIn(bots), FadeIn(tops))
stage.add(bots, tops)

beats.intent: A key sliding in with cuts of different depths under the pins
beats.narration: The key has cuts of different depths, one under each pin.
beats.code:
key = Polygon(*[[x, y, 0] for x, y in [(-4.0, -1.0)] + [(x0, 0.4 - c - 0.05) for x0, c in zip(xs, cuts)] + [(3.3, -0.5), (3.3, -1.0)]],
              color=GREY_A, fill_opacity=0.6)
key.shift(3 * LEFT)
stage.play(FadeIn(key))
stage.play(key.animate.shift(3 * RIGHT), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(key)

beats.intent: Each pin stack lifted so the gap between its two pins sits exactly on the shear line
beats.narration: Each cut lifts its pins by just the right amount: the join between the lower and upper pin lands exactly on the shear line.
beats.code:
stage.play(*[b.animate.move_to([x, 0.4 - c / 2, 0]) for b, x, c in zip(bots, xs, cuts)],
           *[t.animate.move_to([x, 0.4 + 0.35, 0]) for t, x in zip(tops, xs)])
stage.caption("every join on the shear line")

beats.intent: The plug and key turning free while the body stays put
beats.narration: Nothing crosses the shear line any more, so the plug turns. The wrong key leaves at least one pin in the way.
beats.code:
arrow = CurvedArrow([3.8, -0.8, 0], [3.8, 0.2, 0], color=GREEN)
stage.play(Create(arrow), VGroup(plug, bots, key).animate.shift(0.12 * DOWN))
stage.add(arrow)
stage.caption("the plug turns: unlocked")
